description: Closes QA beans qou-3o9x (re-derive the AME2020 literals of gap10_tjon_correlation_probe.py from library/mass_1.mas20.txt so a re-upload is caught by source_sha), qou-f3ec and qou-l4cm (cross-check the corpus Tjon ladder against the external sources, mismatch informative either way, no back-fitting). Part A derives B(2H), B(3H), B(4He) from the AME2020 mass table and shows rho_strong[3] is a 5-digit rounding while rho_strong[4] is a Coulomb-corrected value whose +0.694 MeV correction had no source in the corpus and is now checked against [platter2005tjon]. Part B scores against [hammer2007fourbody]'s universal B4/B3 = 5 and finds the simplex basis assigns that no-four-body-force system a LARGER mu4 than nature's, with the mu4 = 0 baseline provably unable to reach ratio 5 at all. Lean backing: QOU.MassTheory.TjonSimplexForm universal_ratio_forces_mu4, tjon_baseline_lt_four_ratio, universal_ratio_not_in_tjon_baseline, four_sub_two_mul_three (sorry-free, generic CommRing). VERDICT: AME2020 re-derivation: rho_strong[3] literal 3.8128 is a 5-digit rounding of the derived 3.812786601 (rel 3.51e-6); rho_strong[4] literal 13.0316 is NOT an AME ratio (raw 12.71963154) but implies B = 28.989657 MeV, a Coulomb correction of +0.694 MeV now sourced to [platter2005tjon]'s B_alpha^exp = 29.0 +/- 0.1 (inside: True). CROSS-CHECK against [hammer2007fourbody]'s universal B4/B3 = 5, the field's own parameter-free target: feeding that ratio into the C(A,k) basis gives mu4 = 9*mu2 + mu3 = 9.8128, i.e. 2.6x LARGER than nature's mu4 for a calculation that carries NO four-body input at all — a stronger form of TjonSimplexForm's thesis that mu4's size is a basis artifact. (Weak reading only: 'no four-body parameter needed at LO' is not 'no four-body force exists'; [jurgenson2009srg] puts the 4N force at tens-to-hundreds of keV, and Yamashita et al. dispute the LO claim generally while exempting nucleons, the case at issue.) Sharper: the mu4 = 0 baseline has M(4) < 4*M(3) strictly for any mu2 > 0 (Lean tjon_baseline_lt_four_ratio), so ratio 5 is outside its reachable range and the EFT's 'no four-body parameter' is PROVABLY NOT the simplex's mu4 = 0 (universal_ratio_not_in_tjon_baseline) — the paper motivates the baseline, it does not derive it. For the operator the external number makes the standing gap WIDER: operator 1.26 < nature 3.418 < universal 5. Scope-(a) NEGATIVE on the operator's ladder growth against one further target; no ingredient excluded, nothing fitted, nothing wired.
